name: sites
description: Agent-agnostic website building and hosting, with a frontier-grade design and quality pipeline: intake specification, design tokens, accessible components, motion and PWA craft, rubric critique, and objective quality gates. Build, validate, package, serve, and hand off full-stack sites from any machine, through any agent.

interface.shortDescription: Design and build beautiful sites with any agent
interface.longDescription: Build, design, validate, package, serve, and hand off websites — landing pages, portfolios, dashboards, portals, trackers, hubs, games, PWAs, and internal tools — with any agent, on any machine. Ships a complete craft pipeline: an intake spec that resolves ambiguity before building, a design-token system (W3C DTCG) with accessible React primitives, motion and PWA capability, a rubric-driven critique loop with a vision pass, and objective quality gates (Lighthouse, axe-core). The engine is fully open source (vinext, Vite, Drizzle, Tailwind, wrangler); hosting is pluggable, so finished sites go wherever their human wants them.
